mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates demand misallocation toward housing, causing economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of HOUST decline/RSAFS rise instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output growth exceeding 0.5% monthly (INDPRO) signals supply-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO growth > 0.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) over 6 months sustains consumer spending momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation rise (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS) indicates policy uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL rise/FEDFUNDS decline instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Post-recession recovery phase (rising HOUST and RSAFS) strengthens consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST/RSAFS rising periods, or joint condition Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
